description: Skyway Air support documentation and staff discussion about bookings made through travel agencies.

files.description: A Confluence page in the support-playbooks space for support agents about bookings made through travel agencies, last updated between 2026-01-12 and 2026-05-15. It must contain these sentences word for word: "the agency processes the refund"; "label the ticket agency-refund"; "meal, hotel and bag reimbursements are still ours". Do not state any other policy amount, limit, deadline or rule. Any example situation must fit these sentences: do not show anyone giving, arranging or refusing a hotel, meal, voucher, credit, refund or compensation beyond what they say, and do not set an example in a weather, air traffic control or airport security disruption unless they mention it. Do not mention battery, batteries, lithium, power bank, watt-hour.
